name: adwhispr-ads-manager
description: Launch, manage and optimize your own ad accounts from chat on Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google Ads, TikTok, X, ChatGPT Ads, Reddit and LinkedIn. Use when the user wants to manage their ads, see how campaigns are doing, find wasted spend, pause or resume a campaign, change a budget, keywords or targeting, add an audience or ad group, or launch a new campaign. Reads real spend, clicks and conversions with keyword-level diagnostics on Google Search; changes budgets, geography, keywords and negative keywords with a preview-and-confirm step; launches complete Search, YouTube, Shopping, Meta, TikTok, X, ChatGPT, Reddit and LinkedIn campaigns from the user's own creatives. Every campaign is created paused, so nothing spends until the user resumes it. Ad accounts connect on each platform's own sign-in screen; no API keys in chat, no hooks, data flows only to AdWhispr's own API. No creative generation.
